content.short: nowarp provides TON smart contract audits and Misti, a static analysis tool for Tact based contracts.
content.description: nowarp is a TON focused security team that combines audit services with internal tooling for contract review. Its public documentation highlights Misti, a static analysis tool for contracts written in Tact, alongside broader security work for TON builders. The platform is relevant for teams that want earlier detection of risky patterns, CI friendly analysis, and security assessments tailored to the TON development stack rather than general purpose EVM review processes. That makes it useful both before deployment and during active contract development.
content.meta: nowarp offers TON smart contract audits and Misti analysis tooling for Tact developers and security focused teams on Lancers Web3 Explorer.

resources.title: Compiler Testing: Coverage-Guided Fuzzing with Grammars and LLMs
resources.tldr: Fuzzing small-language compilers means few optimisation passes, tiny corpora and thin docs. The adaptation found 100+ compiler bugs.

resources.title: Compiler Testing: Metamorphic Testing with Verified Identities
resources.tldr: Miscompilation is the bug class that drains funds: valid program in, silently different behaviour out. Differential and metamorphic testing for it.

resources.title: TON Security Risks from a Static Analysis View
resources.tldr: Contracts are unforgiving and a single bug vaporises real money. Where static analysis catches TON-specific mistakes before deployment.
